meaning_by_symbol.P1: Sound a sustained {I} tone near all six faces simultaneously for {D} seconds, starting from the {F} face. Let the tone fade naturally and wait for the hum to stabilize.
meaning_by_symbol.P2: Chime a bell near two opposite faces, starting from the {F} face. Alternate the chime between the two faces — {D} seconds pause between chimes — for five cycles at {I} tone.
meaning_by_symbol.P3: Drape a cloth over two adjacent edges near the {F} face for {D} seconds at {I} coverage. Then chime a bell three times near the {F} face.
meaning_by_symbol.P4: Warm each corner of the {F} face by holding a heated stone nearby for {D} seconds at {I} warmth, in sequence. Then trace each edge of the {F} face with a finger.
meaning_by_symbol.P5: Place a warm stone beside the {F} face at {I} warmth for {D} seconds. Rotate and repeat for each face.
meaning_by_symbol.P6: Drape a cool cloth over the Veyru for {D} seconds. Remove the cloth and fan {I} cool air across the {F} face and the opposite face for {D} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P7: Illuminate the {F} face with a dim lamp and the opposite face with a bright lamp simultaneously at {I} brightness for {D} seconds, without moving the lamps.
meaning_by_symbol.P8: Drape a folded cloth over the {F} face for {D} seconds at {I} coverage. Then chime a bell near each edge of the {F} face twice.
meaning_by_symbol.P9: At each corner of the {F} face, chime a bell briefly at {I} tone, then warm the two edges meeting at that corner with a heated stone for {D} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P10: Rest a flat board against the {F} face at {I} contact for {D} seconds. Rotate and repeat for each face-pair.
meaning_by_symbol.P11: Chime a bell near the center of each face once at {I} tone, starting from the {F} face. Then place a warm stone beside the Veyru for {D} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P12: Place the Veyru on a soft surface with the {F} face up at {I} contact. Let it rest undisturbed for {D} seconds.
meaning_by_symbol.P13: Drape a cool cloth over the Veyru for {D} seconds. Remove and fan {I} cool air across all six faces for {D} seconds, starting from the {F} face.
meaning_by_symbol.P14: Rotate the Veyru slowly over {D} seconds while sounding a steady tone at {I} volume near opposite faces, starting from the {F} face. After rotation, chime a bell once near each corner.

reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry compositional paradigm is attested in the supplied codebook. The numbered procedures P1–P14 fail the opaque index test: the numerals do not contribute literal count meaning but select unrelated stored procedures. Standalone items like LO/HI, face labels, channels, and objects may look semantically class-like, but there are no actual surface codes in which they alternate in a shared morphotactic frame to form predictable whole meanings. The procedure glosses mention placeholders {F}, {I}, and {D}, but those variables are only inside English descriptions; they are not realized as segmented parts of any supplied symbol. Candidate family P1~P10–P14 is rejected as accidental prefix overlap only. Therefore the safest complete analysis is a flat lexicon with no segmented entries, classes, or constructions.
